live_observations.method: Bounded offline probes against grok 1.0.34 in an isolated temporary home (HOME/GROK_HOME redirected) and scratch directories; no repository paths, no personal configuration, no credentials, no model calls.
live_observations.auth_before_validation: Headless -p with an invalid --session-id and --resume of an unknown UUID both stop at sign-in in an unauthenticated home, so flag-validation order could not be observed; the adapter validates UUID shape before emitting either flag.
live_observations.cwd: grok --cwd <dir> inspect --json reports the requested directory in its cwd field.
live_observations.hooks_discovery: A hand-written hooks/bfb.json with the BFB SessionStart entry is discovered by grok inspect --json as a user hook with the exact command target.
live_observations.mcp_round_trip: grok mcp add bfb -- <launcher> mcp stdio writes [mcp_servers.bfb] with command, args, and enabled; grok mcp list --json returns the same command and args.
live_observations.sandbox_rejection: --sandbox bogus-profile refuses to start with exit 1 instead of running unsandboxed.
live_observations.sessions_and_usage: sessions list reports no sessions in an empty home; usage of an unknown session exits 1 with a not-found error.
live_observations.tui_probes_avoided: --resume in TUI mode blocks waiting on the terminal, so TUI-invoking probes were terminated rather than completed; no TUI behavior is claimed.
live_observations.version: grok --version prints grok 1.0.34 (<build>) [stable]; the channel suffix is absent under a bare temporary home.

scope: Adapter contract certification against the frozen L03 kit with an owned stub executable and synthetic fixtures. Live model runs were never attempted; only the observed behaviors below ground adapter decisions.
